title: Contract Pricing Agreement Conditions: One Agreement per Customer
content:
**Clause 1 — One agreement per customer.** A customer holds at most one Contract Pricing Agreement (a limit of 1 per customer); every ship-to, StockSmart program and VendPoint program of the customer buys at that agreement's prices.

**Clause 2 — No second proposal while an agreement is live.** A new proposal is not issued while the customer has an agreement whose status is proposed, active or renewal pending. A change of tier on a live agreement is made by a tier change recorded on that same agreement, never by a second agreement.

**Basis of the check.** The statuses compared are those recorded on the customer's agreement records, matched to the customer the proposal would be issued to; a customer's own account of its agreement does not replace the record.

| Status recorded on an existing agreement of the same customer | New proposal |
|---|---|
| Proposed | Not issued |
| Active | Not issued |
| Renewal pending | Not issued |

Hypothetical case: a customer whose agreement shows renewal pending asks for a proposal at a higher tier. Clause 2 applies: no new proposal is issued, and a tier change is made on the live agreement itself.
